BitLocker XTS-AES-256 + NTFS (64 MiB), with BitLocker's metadata inside the volume as Windows places it (at 44, 52 and 60 MiB, the moved first sectors after the second). Unlocked, then formatted from the card's More menu as exFAT (full overwrite): the new exFAT keeps off BitLocker's metadata and marks it bad, flower.jpg is gone, a new file survives an unmount and unlock with the same password. Host: cryptsetup still releases the key, the volume decrypted with Python's AES, fsck.exfat, flower.jpg absent and none of its bytes left in the plaintext, after_erase.txt present.
